tasks.name: Database schema implementation and migration scripts
User authentication system (registration, login, password reset)
File upload service and storage configuration
Note detail view and download functionality
Security implementation (HTTPS, password hashing, input validation)

milestones: Week 2: Database schema implemented and authentication system complete
Week 4: Note upload, search, and management features functional
Week 6: Rating system and tag management complete
Week 8: Group creation, management, and discussion forum operational
Week 10: All screens developed and responsive design implemented
Week 11: Security, performance, and accessibility requirements met
Week 12: Testing complete, documentation finished, system deployed
risks: University email verification may require coordination with IT departments - mitigation: start early, have fallback manual verification
File storage costs may exceed budget - mitigation: implement file size limits, consider compression
Scalability issues with concurrent users - mitigation: implement caching, load testing early
Malware scanning service integration complexity - mitigation: research solutions early, have manual review fallback
User adoption may be slow - mitigation: plan marketing strategy, incentivize early adopters
Data privacy compliance complexity - mitigation: consult legal expert, implement privacy by design
Third-party service dependencies (email, storage) - mitigation: choose reliable providers, have backup options
Browser compatibility issues - mitigation: test on all major browsers throughout development
Timeline pressure may compromise quality - mitigation: prioritize high-priority features, maintain quality gates
